digest.component_or_area: outbound type mapping and config-driven type resolution
propositions: Config-driven type mapping must be threaded through all three OutboundMapper implementations and their field mappers to remap local ticket types to Jira types consistently.
Type resolution must fail-closed at load time before the mutation loop when a syncable type is undecided (not mapped or marked SKIP).
Per-project SKIP entries in type_map must be collected into effective_excluded_sync_types and used at both consumers (loop and absent-gets path).
Round-trip safety requires a rebar-type: annotation label stamped when collapsing types, recovered inbound via reverse-map-free recovery, and excluded from all four internal label prefix filters.
The jira_to_local_type reverse map must maintain parity with inbound_fields._JIRA_TO_LOCAL_TYPE to support lossy-stamp detection.
Unmapped local types must not silently coerce to a default; instead, fail-closed validation must ensure all non-skipped syncable types resolve to a configured target.
